name: frontend-design (official plugin)
summary: Official plugin with a model-invocable skill for UI work. Not offered by setup, because bench v2 can't measure UI quality. The manual keeps v7's advice: only for a new frontend without a design system, installed for that repository only. It pulls against Ponytail on UI work.

evidence.source: PLAYBOOK.md v7.3 (frontend-design: new frontends only, repo scope); https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official/tree/main/plugins/frontend-design
evidence.effect: Helps new frontends without a design system (expected, not measured)

revisit: the bench gains a UI grader
maintenance: First-party plugin in the official marketplace.
